notes.title: Jylko V3.1
notes.notes:
Surprise update! 
[i]Well, all updates are surprises since I never communicate in advance, but I felt like saying it :)[/i]

So, I'm really happy to introduce you : [b]Jylko 3.1 !!![/b]
A big uptade focused on gameplay variation, story and improvement of existing content !!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714258/8e599975a5afea9354bfe8a01b475ade2e009b6a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714258/2f7d32358d9d194bdc2cce948dbfd74c4be07b20.png[/img]

[u][b]Major changes :[/b][/u]

- 3 new npcs !

[u][b]The Guard :[/b][/u]
He's the only one to have escaped the attack on the village
And he'll reward you for every task you complete

[u][b]The Musician :[/b][/u]
Can be find in the dungeon
It will give you access to a brand new mini game : Rhythm game !
For the moment, only one track is available
But obviously that new tracks will be added in the future
New leaderboard added for each songs
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714258/c75806ff9536deeef9cd1eeb4063c42023510ed2.jpg[/img]

[u][b]The Tamer :[/b][/u]
Can be find in the dungeon by increasing the difficulty
Once you've saved her, you'll be able to find eggs
These eggs can hatch into creatures which give various stats once equipped
To give them more experience, you'll need to kill monsters while being equipped
You'll also need to make sure they have something to eat
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714258/64888f76ccef45c2ad9715198d38d700133bff79.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714258/4d30f67226de8e412fab0fecf504dfb4dc428eed.png[/img]

[u][b]Fishing :[/b][/u]
The fishing game has been completely redone !
A new fish-catching animation and a fish stock
Creatures need fish to gain experience, but they don't need to give their stats
Feeding is automatic, creatures need one fish for each game (Dungeon or Survival)

[b]New mini-game : Slime Jump[/b]
You can find a new key in the dungeon to get access to this new mini game
Try to get as high as possible while surviving moving platforms and enemies
New leaderboard added for this
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714258/beabad0f075520bf13b53c8186cd2699f57bd0ee.jpg[/img]

[b]The Line V.5 :[/b]
The Line is the music you hear in the background and it has just been updated with new sounds
And it's available on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s5YKGO5lFMk&ab_channel=Jylko%2FRoom12]Youtube[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714258/bc62330cb2f492cc2cc726c45f9d47ccf051b7ef.jpg[/img]

[b]Spells reworked :[/b]
Some spells has been reworked to be more responsive and fun
Create tornado of fire or project explosive rocks to your enemies!

- New cards (Total of 105)
- New Achievements (Total of 73)

[u]Minor changes :[/u]

- New HUD informations (Crit chance, crit damage, bonus damage,...)
- Set the enemies spawn time to 0.4 to 1 sec
- Now it cost golds to increase the difficulty
- The ritual stone in survival mode no longer affects difficulty and gives silver coins
- Normal enemies have a chance to drop consumables
- The cost of rerolls for cards in survival mode is gradually increasing, same for the heal
- Easier to see basic enemy projectiles
- Rewards increased in game mode Dungeon and Survival (Golds and Xp)
- Rewards decreased in grandpa's mini game (Golds and Xp)
- A weapon is automatically dropped in the room 1
- Achievements reward changed (Max HP/Xp/Golds)
- The poison, bleed and fire lasts 4 seconds before being dissipated on ennemies
- Now you can be kicked from the gandpa's house if you bother him too much
- Now quests don't cost anything to be selected
- Damage calculation reworked
- Reducing the mill mini-game level from 40 to 10
- New main menu music set
- Survival leaderboard has been reset
- Cards balance
- Difficulty balance
- Gameplay Improvement and optimization
- Ui improvement

Bugfix :

- Wrong display of lottery rewards
- Enemies could die after a game over
- Game over HUD couldn't display more than 10,000 enemy kills
- Weapon recoil limits to avoir positive recoil

And here's the road map of the next uptade :

- New slot machines
- New ennemies (2 more a least)
- More song for the Rhythm game
- Endgame improvement (Variation to avoid repetitivity)
- Difficulty balance and improvements

I need you !!
If you haven't already done so, I invite you to join the [url=https://discord.gg/5CbsPu9CGH]Discord[/url] to share your ideas and suggestions
You can also give your opinion on the update and in particular for the difficulty balance of new content

Thanks to S'Hill for the music !

Each positive evaluation is a great support and pushes me to go even further. 
So a [b]huge thanks[/b] to everyone for playing Jylko <333

Cya in the leaderboard ;)

Perk.

notes.title: 1 Year of Jylko !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone !

I wanted to celebrate Jylko's [b]1st birthday[/b] with a little uptade !

The environment has its own colot palette now, It took a lot of time to carefully choose the colors to match the enemies and Jylko's colors while keeping them separate. The difference may seem subtle, but the result is much more harmonious.

I've also fixed a few bugs and changed the leaderboard display. 


[u]And now the best player ceremony !![/u]
Congratulations for the top players on the leaderboard !

The highest level is awarded to : [b][u]kackis68[/u][/b]
He has reached [b]level 113 !![/b]

The highest room reached is awarded to : [u][b]Antherron[/b][/u]
He has reached the [b]room 75 !![/b]

The highest number of enemy kills is attributed to : [u][b]Brood Papa[/b][/u]
He killed [b]21 523 enemies[/b] !!!!! Leave some for the others please..

The highest score in grandpa's game is awarded to : [u][b]Davy Mousse[/b][/u]
With a [b]score of 2 864 !![/b]

Congratulations to all of you, and [b]a big thank you to everyone[/b] for playing Jylko <3

Thanks everyone and good luck in the dungeon !

notes.title: Jylko - V.1.0 !
notes.notes:
Jylko V.1.0

The game has been totally changed since the beginning of the Early Access.
It was a great personal experience, both positive and negative. 
The few comments and feedback have helped me a lot.

I can’t afford to invest more time in the development of this game. 
I gave a lot of energy to bring the best I can do. 
That doesn’t mean I give up the game.
I will continue to bring new content on Jylko like :

- New cards
- New sigils
- New environments 
- Steam Deck compatability
- New Game Mode
- Languages
